integrationChecks.result: The focused native matrix remained all true after slice integration: duplicate-start PID stability; async startup cancellation; strict port-zero/malformed/early-exit/readiness-timeout classification; stable late-log diagnostics; crash/PID-changing retry/three-attempt exhaustion; serialized stop/retry; and root-plus-immediate-descendant cleanup on graceful stop, forced stop, Job-handle close, and delayed compatible readiness cancellation.

All three tasks are DONE with exact superseding evidence chains and independent approvals. Generated views, 13-area architecture, and 71-file Python quality inventory pass. The only profile-discovered issue was the initially omitted benchmark/test quality inventory; quality-scope.json was corrected, the focused quality check passed, and the complete authoritative desktop profile then passed from a clean commit.

integratedBehavior: Core provides strict local-only health, readiness, version, configuration, module, OpenAPI, and runtime contracts; actual served responses validate their schema variants and malformed or hybrid states fail closed.

The self-contained Python 3.14.6/PyInstaller 6.21.0 onedir artifact has an exact 644-file identity and dependency inventory, runs without system Python on PATH, binds every identity/version field to the governed build contract, rejects mutation or missing dependencies, and writes reports through confined guarded output.

Tauri lifecycle commands dispatch blocking work off the main thread. Windows creates Core suspended, assigns KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE containment, then resumes it, closing the descendant escape window before application code executes.

Only one lifecycle operation may own or publish the sidecar. Stop, startup cancellation, delayed readiness publication, retry, crash observation, graceful shutdown, forced shutdown, and host-drop cleanup retain ownership until the complete contained process tree is dead.

The renderer receives exactly state, bounded attempt, retry availability, and an allowlisted opaque diagnostic. It receives no endpoint, nonce, PID, path, environment, raw output, credential, or research content; malformed adapter values fail closed and command input remains mounted through recovery.

Production and development expose one functional CAP-01 application page. The 32-page HTML reference, illustrative records, future-capability routes, and nonfunctional actions remain confined to design and conformance tooling and are absent from the product bundle.

The immutable Core performance baseline binds hardware class, fixture contract, methodology, all samples, absolute budgets, and 20 percent regression thresholds; the tool offers no automatic re-baselining path.
failureAndRecoveryCoverage: invalid/missing configuration, malformed and extra-field service contracts, and nonloopback binding denial
missing/mutated/identity-free artifact manifests, missing dependencies, hardlink/redirect output denial, and Pythonless execution
malformed/process-mismatched/port-zero handshake, early exit, readiness timeout, async cancellation, and incompatible readiness
duplicate start, crash after ready, safe retry with new PID, bounded restart exhaustion, and stable state diagnostics after late logs
graceful tree stop, hung five-second forced tree stop, immediate descendant containment, Job-handle-close cleanup, stop/retry overlap, and delayed-readiness cancellation
renderer hostile/credential/URL/path/extra-field adapter results, clipboard failure, retained input, offline continuation, responsive/accessibility behavior, and zero network requests

downstreamHandoff.notes: S04 may consume the versioned process-bound loopback/nonce handshake and public OpenAPI without importing supervisor or service-private modules. The endpoint and nonce remain native-host private until S04 adds authenticated transport and a generated renderer-safe client.

residualLimitations: Authenticated request transport, capability tokens, generated client compatibility, cancellation IDs, and request traces are intentionally owned by CAP-01.S04.
Installer signing, install/upgrade/repair/rollback, clean-VM packaging, and external artifacts are intentionally owned by CAP-01.S05.
Project persistence and scholarly workflows remain owned by later capabilities; S03 does not fabricate their UI or data.
